explanation: Each hand has 27 bones and each foot 26, which makes 106 of the 206. Babies start with more bones than adults, because many fuse together as they grow.

claims.text: More than half of the adult human body's 206 bones are in the hands and feet.
The spine and ribs together hold about 50 bones and the skull and face about 22, far fewer than half of 206.
Each human hand has 27 bones and each foot has 26.
The two hands and two feet together hold 106 of the adult skeleton's 206 bones.
Babies have more bones than adults because many bones fuse during growth.
